gui.description: Qt6 Widgets MIDAS verification GUI (apps/verification-gui) plus its Qt-independent verification/ library (ExcelReferenceReader, via xlnt for .xlsx); not built by default, requested only via -DVCPKG_MANIFEST_FEATURES=gui so the routine Ubuntu CI matrix in ci.yml never builds Qt6/xlnt from source. qtbase is requested with default-features:false + an explicit minimal {gui,widgets,thread} list ('core' is implicit, cannot be named) -- confirmed by reading Qt's own src/corelib/configure.cmake: QProcess ('process' feature) requires 'CONDITION QT_FEATURE_thread OR NOT UNIX', so on Linux QProcess simply does not exist without 'thread' explicitly requested; a prior attempt adding 'network' instead (based on Bitcoin Core's own minimal qtbase feature list, which happens to need QtNetwork for its own unrelated reasons) did not fix it and was reverted (GUI-7, 2026-10-21/22). Still excludes qtbase's heavier default-features that are genuinely unused here (dbus, sql-psql, sql-sqlite, testlib, icu, harfbuzz, brotli, network, opengl, openssl, async-io, sessionmanager, dnslookup, zstd), which is what was exhausting a GitHub-hosted Ubuntu runner's disk building them from source. windeployqt is requested only on Windows (platform-filtered), since it is a Windows-only deployment tool with no effect on Linux.
